programme.title: Mayas : La Guerre Des Rois Divins

Mais en 378, une intervention militaire menée par la lointaine Teotihuacan, un événement nommé l'Entrada, bouleverse l'ordre politique. Cet assaut instaure une nouvelle ère à Tikal, marquée par un système hybride mêlant les traditions mayas aux influences du centre du Mexique.

programme.title: Mayas : La Guerre Des Rois Divins

L'ascension de la dynastie des Rois Serpents de Calakmul bouleverse cet équilibre en défiant son rival, Tikal. Cela déclenche une spirale de violence qui va entraîner tous les royaumes dans une guerre de deux siècles. Alliances, trahisons et rituels cruels mènent cette lutte sans merci à l'effondrement de la civilisation.

programme.title: Leigh-Anne: Race, Pop and Power
programme.desc: This powerful documentary follows pop star Leigh-Anne Pinnock as she confronts her experience as the only black member of Little Mix, and as a black woman in the music industry. Leigh-Anne talks about the racism she experienced growing up. Both her parents are of Caribbean heritage, and Leigh-Anne identifies as black. She is also aware that having lighter skin and being a celebrity means she is in a more privileged position than others. Leigh-Anne embarks on her own very personal journey to understand how she can use her platform and privilege to combat the profound racism she sees in society around her. After she begins her journey, news of George Floyd’s death and the Black Lives Matter protests start to sweep the world. With the force of a global movement now behind her, Leigh-Anne confronts those closest to her and attempts to bring difficult conversations about black representation right to the top of the music industry.

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: Andrew and dad Terrence are spinning plates on the farm, and with their glamping pods, just as the latest member of the Glenn family arrives. Long days on the dairy shed build and an infection in Adam’s leg mean he is desperate for a new prosthetic. Meanwhile, Ally and fellow crofters set sail to the stunning volcanic Shiant Isles, where they must navigate steep cliffs to find and shear sheep.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie heads for Ben Ledi in the Trossachs to help with some high-altitude fieldwork. And 25 years on from the foot-and-mouth outbreak, Arlene finds out about a legacy that is helping today's farmers. Elsewhere, Rosie is in Gairloch Wester Ross to hunt for herring and find out how this over-exploited species is making a comeback. Leanna is in Fife, where she joins a team researching the movements of secretive snipe, and Cammy visits the Ayrshire couple determined to preserve and promote the Clydesdale horse breed.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: There is lots of planting for the plate at Beechgrove Garden as Kirsty Wilson and Brian Cunningham start growing a wide variety of edible produce. Kirsty is the first of the Beechgrove team to kick off work on her competition plot. Each presenter has been given a sense to appeal to in each of their competition borders, and Kirsty is planting things that will taste fantastic. She is also trying something new to Beechgrove: hops. Meanwhile, Brian provides an update on the veg he sowed at the start of the series and is in his rain garden checking on what survived this year's wet weather. There are all the usual handy hints, and there is a visit to Calum Clunie’s allotment in Leven.

programme.title: The Mountain
programme.desc: The summer months bring new opportunities for the hardy folk who live in the shadow of Cairngorm. As the summer comes to a close with a big splash, the mountain gets its new ski tow installed in the nick of time, and Polly and Ross count the cost of a busy summer.

programme.title: Wha's Like Us
programme.desc: Sanjeev Kohli takes a humorous look at how films have shown Scots, the Scots character and stereotypes, celebrating some of our most memorable onscreen moments. Are we really as mean, parochial and up for a fight as the movies often make us out to be? Sanjeev examines which Scottish stereotypes have a whiff of truth and which ones should be fed to the Loch Ness Monster. Packed with great film clips from both famous classics and lesser-known cult gems, the programme features contributions from an impressive supporting cast list, including actors Kate Dickie, Clare Grogan, Gary Lewis, Denis Lawson, Alex Norton and Tam Dean Burn. From popular adaptations of Kidnapped and Rob Roy to war dramas such as The Great Escape, from the wily islanders of Whisky Galore to the dark urban humour of films such as Shallow Grave, we look at what stories these films have told the world about us, and what these characters can teach us about ourselves. We eavesdrop on tourists taking in the sights with an Outlander tour, drawn to visit Scotland through our most expensive ever drama production, and we celebrate an unexpected staple of Scottish cinema: Scottish men crying.

programme.desc: Vincent Larivière de l'UdeM s'intéresse à l'évaluation quantitative plutôt que qualitative des chercheurs et chercheuses, qui se voient attribuer une cote liée au nombre et à l'impact de leurs publications scientifiques.

programme.title: Mission : guérir
programme.desc: Dans les laboratoires d'hôpitaux, les technologistes médicaux font un travail méconnu, mais essentiel, sachant que 85% des diagnostics rendus par les médecins sont basés sur des analyses de laboratoire. Qu'ils tentent de dépister une bactérie microscopique dans un échantillon de sang ou analyser un organe entier, les technologistes savent qu'une erreur de leur part pourrait mettre la vie d'un patient en danger.

programme.title: Hallucinant!
programme.desc: On se demande si vapoter est moins dangereux que fumer la cigarette.

programme.title: Point tournant: Ville de Québec
programme.desc: En explorant la mobilité durable, on découvre les solutions actuelles en termes de transports et de planification du territoire; on explique l'approche RTA et ses trois priorités à respecter pour réduire la dépendance à l'automobile.

programme.title: Journée de prof
programme.desc: L'usage des drogues, sa stigmatisation et son encadrement politique: c'est le domaine de recherche de Jean-Sébastien Fallu, professeur à l'École de psychoéducation de l'UdeM. Il tente aussi de comprendre pourquoi certaines personnes développent des problèmes de dépendance et d'autres non. En tant que membre du syndicat des professeur.e.s de l'UdeM, il est heureux de défendre les droits de ses collègues et de veiller à ce que l'institution ne déroge pas à sa mission...

programme.title: Parlons job
programme.desc: Il y a un siècle, à Hull, des ouvrières d'une usine d'allumettes développent une maladie grave de la mâchoire à cause d'une exposition au phosphore blanc ; dans les décennies qui suivent, la présence de substances toxiques s'accroît en milieu de travail, entraînant nombre de maladies professionnelles ; les toxicologues industriels entrent alors en scène ; un de leurs succès : l'outil informatique Mixie, développé à l'IRSST, qui permet de quantifier l'effet sur la santé.

programme.title: La société du travail
programme.desc: Le mot travail provient du mot latin tripalium, qui désigne un instrument de torture; heureusement, de nos jours, le travail est plutôt vu comme porteur de sens; en effet, il constitue le facteur d'intégration par excellence.

programme.title: Dehors, l'école!
programme.desc: De plus en plus d'universités et de cégeps intègrent le plein air dans la formation des futurs enseignants ; ainsi, au Cégep de Granby, les étudiants en Techniques d'éducation spécialisée travaillent leur voix pour qu'elle porte davantage ; c'est important quand on est responsable d'un groupe à l'extérieur ; dans une forêt enneigée des Laurentides, des étudiants à la maîtrise au programme d'intervention en plein air de l'UQAM testent une activité.

programme.title: Mairies: nouvelle génération
programme.desc: Le Québec est aux prises avec une crise du logement sans précédent; nos mairesses et maires n'ont pas dit leur dernier mot; les projets et les idées foisonnent; et la plupart ont déjà la main à la pâte pour tenter de les réaliser.

programme.title: Bâtir ensemble
programme.desc: Les coopératives permettent aux membres de prendre en charge leur logement; comme la plupart des membres n'ont pas ou peu d'expérience de gestion, découvrez le rôle d'une équipe de formation dans les mois qui précèdent l'entrée dans leur logement.

programme.title: Substances
programme.desc: Le Xanax et les benzodiazépines, souvent prescrits pour réduire le stress, sont aussi détournés à des fins récréatives; leur usage croissant chez les jeunes et leur potentiel addictif suscitent des inquiétudes; Sara Buzzell explore cette réalité.

programme.title: Les patientes
programme.desc: Les femmes ont davantage tendance à ressentir et à signaler la douleur que les hommes. De plus, près de 70% des personnes qui souffrent de douleur chronique sont des femmes. Malgré tout, les médecins leur prescriraient moins d'analgésiques qu'aux hommes pour le même niveau de douleur rapporté. La douleur des femmes est-elle prise au sérieux? En quoi diffère-t-elle de celle des hommes?

programme.title: De la scie au bistouri
programme.desc: L'univers tabou et complexe des infections transmises sexuellement et par le sang (ITSS).

programme.title: Naissances du futur
programme.desc: Grâce aux avancées de la génétique, le diagnostic préimplantatoire et la modification de l'ADN permettent d'éviter certaines maladies héréditaires ; en suivant le parcours d'un couple confronté à une mutation génétique, nous soulevons un débat essentiel : où tracer la frontière entre prévention médicale et sélection des embryons ?

programme.title: Hélène reste en forme
programme.desc: Nous négligeons souvent le fait de nous étirer; on se demande comment savoir si nous sommes suffisamment flexibles, même sans réussir à faire un grand écart; et il est souvent question de mobilité lors des entraînements: de quoi s'agit-il au juste?

programme.title: Journée de prof

programme.title: La vie continue
programme.desc: Le cancer du sein est celui qui touche le plus les femmes au pays; environ une femme sur huit sera atteinte d'un cancer du sein au cours de sa vie et une sur 34 en mourra.

programme.title: Face à la détresse
programme.desc: Incursion dans le quotidien de trois professionnelles qui oeuvrent auprès des jeunes vulnérables: une éducatrice dans un centre jeunesse, une travailleuse sociale et une avocate, toutes deux à l'emploi de la DPJ du Québec.

programme.title: Bâtir ensemble
programme.desc: Découvrez le travail du développeur immobilier communautaire "Bâtir son quartier," de la conception à la livraison d'un projet de logement social; quels sont les défis qui jalonnent la création de ces milieux de vie?

programme.title: Bâtir ensemble
programme.desc: On découvre les grandes étapes d'un chantier de construction de logements sociaux et communautaires; on voit également comment certains ensembles locatifs sont achetés pour être sortis du marché, avant d'être rénovés.

programme.title: Bâtir ensemble
programme.desc: Alors que de nombreux bâtiments patrimoniaux se cherchent une nouvelle vocation, les transformer en logements sociaux est une solution intéressante; pourquoi des communautés religieuses se tournent vers des promoteurs immobiliers communautaires.

programme.title: Bâtir ensemble
programme.desc: Le logement social offre souvent plus qu'un toit aux personnes qui y habitent; c'est aussi un endroit adapté à leurs besoins; découvrez comment les équipes de Bâtir son quartier, un développeur immobilier communautaire, s'assurent que tout est réfléchi pour créer des milieux de vie appropriés et sécuritaires.

programme.title: Bâtir ensemble
programme.desc: Les coopératives permettent aux membres de prendre en charge leur logement; comme la plupart des membres n'ont pas ou peu d'expérience de gestion, découvrez le rôle d'une équipe de formation dans les mois qui précèdent l'entrée dans leur logement.

programme.title: Bâtir ensemble
programme.desc: Alors que nous vivons une crise du logement actuellement, on découvre quelles sont les pistes de solutions pour l'avenir, mais aussi les nouvelles façons de construire qui devront être adoptées pour faire face aux changements climatiques.

programme.title: Fleuve en eaux troubles
programme.desc: La baleine noire, avec moins de 360 individus, est en péril malgré l'interdiction de la chasse; son principal danger vient des empêtrements dans les cordages de pêcheurs de crabes des neiges; nous explorons les efforts de collaboration entre scientifiques et pêcheurs en Gaspésie pour protéger les baleines tout en soutenant l'économie locale.

programme.title: Créatures microscopiques
programme.desc: Les excréments des animaux sont riches en informations scientifiques. Chloé se rend au Zoo de Granby pour prélever les déjections des tigres, des éléphants, des kangourous et des émeus.

programme.title: Créatures microscopiques
programme.desc: Le sang menstruel, le lait maternel, le mucus nasal et les larmes : le corps produit différents liquides qui sont fascinants pour une microbiologiste.

programme.title: La préhistoire du Québec
programme.desc: La construction du barrage Daniel-Johnson a révélé l'un des cratères d'astéroïde les plus spectaculaires au monde, une cicatrice géante dans le paysage québécois visible depuis l'espace. Des expert.e.s nous dévoilent les secrets enfouis dans la région de Manicouagan. Découvrez l'ampleur de ce choc colossal survenu il y a 214 millions d'années.

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: On appelle magnétosphère le champ magnétique qui entoure la Terre. Ce bouclier nous protège contre les bombardements d'énergie provenant du Soleil. C'est donc grâce à la magnétosphère que la vie sur Terre s'est développée. Et même si elle est invisible, on peut toutefois la voir à l'œuvre lors des aurores boréales.

programme.title: Facteurs de risque : en 1 minute

programme.desc: D'où viennent tous nos noms d'herbe; si l'herbe verdit dans les champs, le mot herbe tapisse le français québécois, tant et si bien qu'il fait parfois perdre la carte.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Don't be ridiculous! When it comes to Internet videos run amok, however, the more zany, unbelievable and downright dangerous the clips are, the greater the chance they'll be shown on this series. It features amateur viral videos being critiqued by MTV personality Rob Dyrdek ("Rob Dyrdek's Fantasy Factory"), who knows a thing or two about pushing the envelope from his pro skateboarding days. With commentary from Sterling "Steelo" Brim and Chanel (the rapping receptionist from "Fantasy Factory"), Dyrdek breaks down the clips by putting them in such categories as "Hot Mess," "Worst Case Scenario," "Redneck Good Times" and "What Happened Last Night." It's sure to be seriously ridiculous.

programme.title: Trains deux siècles d'innovation
programme.desc: Chaque jour en France, 15.000 trains circulent emportant à leur bord plus de 4 millions de passagers. Chaque année, 2 milliards de personnes passent par l'une des 3.000 gares françaises. Depuis presque 200 ans, le train a révolutionné notre façon de vivre, modifié nos notions des distances et du temps et redessiné notre territoire.

programme.title: L'épopée des sous-marins français
programme.desc: Depuis plus de 100 ans, les sous-marins sont au coeur d'une véritable course technologique. Ces géants d'acier invisibles fascinent ingénieurs et militaires qui se livrent une guerre sans merci pour mettre au point les bâtiments les plus innovants.

programme.title: Fin des programmes

programme.title: Cannes 1939, le festival n'aura pas lieu
programme.desc: En 1939, alors que l'Europe est sur le point de s'embraser et de sombrer dans la Seconde Guerre mondiale, le gouvernement français, alors représenté par Jean Zay et Philippe Erlanger, met tout en œuvre pour monter un ambitieux projet de festival destiné à contrer l'emprise des dictatures sur le cinéma. Le but est de tenir tête à la Biennale du cinéma de Venise, liée aux fascistes italiens et aux nazis allemands. La course à l'armement culturel commence.

programme.title: Les coulisses de l'histoire
programme.desc: Le film met à mal deux idées préconçues : la première est celle des soi-disant qualités de stratège militaire du Führer et la deuxième est l'image propre de la Wehrmacht, l'armée allemande, en opposition avec les nazis SS.

programme.title: Les coulisses de l'histoire

programme.title: La France de l'entre-deux-guerres

programme.title: La France de l'entre-deux-guerres

programme.title: AF447: la traque du vol Rio-Paris

Que s'est-il passé ? Quelle a été la part de l'erreur humaine et celle des problèmes techniques ? Cet accident peut-il se reproduire ?

programme.title: Les opérations secrètes nazies

According to myth, the box holds deadly organisms that could kill millions of people. With her old partner, Terry (Gerard Butler), Croft goes on a hunt that takes her from Europe to Asia to Africa, where pal Kosa (Djimon Hounsou) helps her. Along the way, Croft rappels down cliffs, scuba dives and decimates many male opponents.

programme.title: Crisis

When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead.

And each girl is worried about her caregiver. Alyssa's father, Roger (Steve Guttenberg), is about to marry a gold digger, and Amanda's kind social worker, Diane (Kirstie Alley), will be pushed aside if a cruel family adopts Amanda. The girls decide to switch identities to make their loved ones fall in love with each other.

programme.title: Chocolat

Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins.

Problems arise when scientists discover that Gardner's organs can't withstand the atmosphere. United with Tulsa and on the run, the interplanetary visitor races against time to unravel the mysteries of how he came to be, and where he belongs in the universe.

Crisis strikes when a probe dispatched by the energy cloud attacks the crew, abducting navigator Lt. Ilia (Persis Khambatta). An android look-alike containing her memories shows up soon after.

programme.title: Spy Kids 3-D: Game Over

The Toymaker has captured Juni's sister, OSS agent Carmen (Alexa Vega), and is holding her inside a virtual reality environment called "Game Over." programme.desc: Reginald "Cool" Coolidge (Dorian Missick) is an actor hoping for his big break away from stereotypical black roles. programme.desc: Things are tough at Whitehead Correctional Institute, a notorious women's prison. The inmates include Lil' Mamma (Lark Voorhies), a pregnant teen, and Nikki (N'Bushe Wright), the queen bee of Whitehead. The inmates are under the supervision of abusive warden Dease (Clifton Powell), who forces them to endure hours of hard labor, from which he profits. Eventually, the women band together and reach out to part-time prison guard Michael (Mos Def), a law student, who helps them fight for reform.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the most unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie returns to cooking the food he loves the most, getting right to heart of the Italian kitchen.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Jamie tracks down some fast, fresh and easy recipes, featuring tasty minty pea tortiglioni and gnocchi with roasted tomato sauce and rocket pesto.

programme.title: La Pat'Patrouille
programme.desc: La Pat' Patrouille faisait du jus de papaye avant de découvrir que le maire est en danger ; un fermier à besoin d'aide pour sauver sa récolte de maïs lorsque le haut de son silo est arraché.

programme.title: Drôle de bocal

programme.title: La fièvre des festivals

programme.title: The Black Scorpion
programme.desc: After a volcano erupts south of the border, people and animals begin inexplicably dying. Earth scientists Hank (Richard Denning) and Arturo (Carlos Rivas) travel to the small town of San Lorenzo, Mexico to investigate. They soon discover that the eruption cracked open an underground cave that contained hordes of giant prehistoric insects, including the scorpions that have been responsible for the killings. Soon, Hank and Arturo come up with a plan to take these monsters down once and for all.

programme.title: The Beast From 20,000 Fathoms
programme.desc: Near the Arctic Circle researchers detonate a nuclear device and unwittingly thaw a prehistoric beast frozen for millions of years. The monster leaves a path of destruction across eastern North America as it heads straight for New York City. When heavy artillery proves ineffective against the towering creature, scientist Tom Nesbitt (Paul Christian) concocts a radioactive formula to neutralize the beast -- and ace shot Cpl. Stone (Lee Van Cleef) will deliver it by grenade.

programme.title: Forbidden Planet
programme.desc: In this sci-fi classic, a spacecraft travels to the distant planet Altair IV to discover the fate of a group of scientists sent there decades earlier. When Commander John J. Adams and his crew arrive, they discover only two people: Dr. Morbius and his daughter, Altaira, who was born on the remote planet. Soon, Adams begins to uncover the mystery of what happened on Altair IV, and why Morbius and Altaira are the sole survivors.

programme.title: The Invisible Boy
programme.desc: Timmie (Richard Eyer), a mischievous 10-year-old boy, is plopped in front of a supercomputer by his scientist father, Dr. Tom (Philip Abbott). The computer, however, secretly gives Timmie super-intelligence and he's soon able to reanimate a robot named Robbie. Timmie and Robbie become best friends, embarking on a series of lighthearted pranks. But when Robbie starts taking orders from the evil supercomputer, Timmie must choose between his best friend and the safety of the world.

programme.title: The Killer Shrews
programme.desc: Capt. Thorne Sherman lands his ship on an isolated island to make a delivery, only to find that mad doctor Marlowe Craigis is experimenting on shrews in an attempt to shrink them. The opposite happens, and the shrews become enormous and hungry for human flesh, leaving everyone on the island in peril, including the doctor's pretty daughter, Ann, and her unappealing fiancé, Jerry. Then, Thorne tries to organize an escape plan.

programme.title: Them!
programme.desc: While investigating a series of mysterious deaths, Sergeant Ben Peterson (James Whitmore) finds a young girl (Sandy Descher) who is unable to speak. As Peterson joins forces with FBI agent Robert Graham (James Arness) and scientist Dr. Harold Medford (Edmund Gwenn), he discovers that all the incidents are due to giant ants that have been mutated by atomic radiation. Peterson and Graham, with the aid of the military, attempt to find the queen ants and destroy the nests before the danger spreads.

programme.title: Invaders From Mars
programme.desc: Curious adolescent boy David MacLean (Jimmy Hunt) confronts aliens who have set up base in his backyard. The extraterrestrials intend to use mind control on the local townsfolk. Determined to stop the invaders, who have already co-opted his father (Leif Erickson), he attempts to warn others. But when local law officers also succumb, David teams up with astronomer Stuart Kelston (Arthur Franz) and Dr. Pat Blake (Helena Carter), and the trio must fight together to repel the insidious intruders.

programme.title: Médicos, línea de vida
programme.desc: El Instituto de Especialidades Médicas es uno de los hospitales más prestigiosos, y ocupados, que tiene el país, por la cantidad de urgencias que atiende y porque también alberga a las mentes más experimentadas de cada una de las ramas de la medicina. La historia comienza cuando durante una gran emergencia, el Doctor Lara, director del Instituto, niega la admisión de un paciente. Esta decisión es el inicio de una serie de acontecimientos fatídicos, pues el paciente fallece y uno de sus familiares decide vengarse del director Ante la necesidad de un nuevo director, el mejor candidato es el Doctor Gonzalo Olmedo, un reconocido Neurocirujano que ha dedicado su vida a brindar salud y tratamientos a la gente que lo necesita. El nombramiento de Gonzalo no es del agrado del Doctor René Castillo, el Director Administrativo del Instituto, pues él solía sacar ventaja personal a través de negocios turbios con proveedores y laboratorios, entre otros actos de corrupción. En cuanto Gonzalo toma la Dirección, se destapa una cloaca de malos manejos e irregularidades que le hacen comprender que el Instituto está peor de lo que pensaba, pero en vez de rendirse, se propone trabajar arduamente con su equipo de especialistas, para implementar un proceso de atención exitoso. ★ 6.3/10

Le quotidien en fauteuil ou avec une déficience visuelle est analysé avec précision, entre stationnements inadaptés, logements introuvables, trottoirs hostiles et solutions créatives. L'art y trouve aussi sa place, grâce à une salle de spectacle qui traduit la danse en gestes et en mots.

programme.title: Journée de prof
programme.desc: La sociologue Chiara Piazzesi, de l'UQAM, étudie les relations intimes et la sexualité. Une étude pancanadienne qu'elle mène en ce moment avec ses étudiants montre que les gens restent très attachés au romantisme: un résultat inattendu.

programme.title: Dis-moi pas!? La petite histoire des mots d'ici
programme.desc: L'arrivée du printemps au Québec est marquée par l'apparition de la gadoue, aussi appelée slush; si cette bouillie neigeuse n'a rien d'attrayant, l'histoire de ses noms est plutôt absorbante.

programme.title: Les minutes du sexe
programme.desc: On explore les phénomènes biochimiques responsables de l'odeur du sexe féminin.

programme.title: Nordicité
programme.desc: Du ski de fond à la pêche blanche, en passant par le hockey, le patin, les motoneiges et les festivals lumineux, le Québec transforme l'hiver en terrain de jeu et en moteur économique. Entre traditions ancestrales et innovations modernes, la nordicité devient une fête collective où le froid se célèbre et s'apprivoise avec passion et créativité.

programme.title: Bien bâti
programme.desc: Un cottage de Rawdon intrigue par son revêtement de tôle, à l'intérieur comme à l'extérieur ; dans Lotbinière, le bardeau de cèdre décoratif est à l'honneur, et un passionné de la Montérégie revalorise le vieux bois de grange.

programme.title: Parlons job
programme.desc: En 1907, le pont de Québec s'effondre, causant la mort de 76 ouvriers ; perchés à des dizaines de mètres de hauteur, ces derniers n'avaient aucun équipement de sécurité pour se protéger.

programme.title: La course à l'or bleu
programme.desc: Pour plusieurs, l'exportation éventuelle de l'eau québécoise est inévitable.

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: Les sorties spatiales sont loin d'être des promenades de santé. À l'extérieur de la navette, les astronautes font face à un environnement hostile. Chaque sortie comporte des dangers. Il y a des risques de collision avec les débris qui flottent dans l'espace ou encore une fuite du système de ventilation de la combinaison. Et pourtant, la plupart des astronautes considèrent ces sorties dans l'espace comme une incroyable expérience.

programme.title: Les minutes du sexe
programme.desc: On s'intéresse à la façon dont se déplacent les spermatozoïdes dans l'appareil génital féminin, on déconstruit quelques idées reçues sur ces têtards vigoureux et on découvre pourquoi ça prend 200 millions de spermatozoïdes pour féconder un ovule.

programme.title: Hallucinant!
programme.desc: On explore les effets de la psilocybine, le composé actif des champignons magiques.

programme.title: Trouvez l'erreur
programme.desc: Une des glandes que l'on retrouve au niveau du cou s'appelle la glande thyroïde et non tyrolienne ; chez le médecin, utiliser le mauvais terme pourrait conduire au mauvais traitement.

programme.title: Changer le monde
programme.desc: Rémi Quirion, le premier scientifique en chef du Québec, nous guide dans l'univers fascinant de la recherche scientifique au Québec; on rencontre les acteurs et actrices clés de cette communauté, on se demande quels sont leurs défis les plus importants, on se questionne sur la place de la recherche en français sur l'échiquier international, on découvre les grandes avancées québécoises et comment celles-ci peuvent profiter à la population pour changer le monde de demain.

programme.title: Journée de prof
programme.desc: Magaly Brodeur est à la fois médecin et chercheuse à l'UdeS. Ses travaux visent à mieux comprendre les dépendances comportementales (jeu, écrans) et à améliorer les soins de santé et les services sociaux pour les personnes atteintes. De plus, elle supervise une quinzaine d'étudiant.e.s gradué.e.s et consacre le tiers de son temps à la clinique universitaire. Pour accomplir toutes ses tâches, elle aimerait que ses journées durent 36 heures!

programme.title: Face à la détresse
programme.desc: Notre caméra suit un travailleur social en tournée dans un campement d'itinérance et une organisatrice communautaire en visite dans un organisme d'aide alimentaire; une troisième professionnelle aide les personnes à se libérer d'une dépendance.

programme.title: Louis T veut savoir
programme.desc: Sceptique de nature, Louis T ne croit pas en l'astrologie et peine à s'expliquer sa popularité renouvelée; il explore le phénomène en discutant avec divers spécialistes et en rencontrant une astrologue populaire sur les réseaux sociaux.

programme.title: La vie continue
programme.desc: Le cancer des poumons est un cancer redoutable à qui on doit le plus grand nombre de décès par années par cancer au Québec et au Canada, tant chez les hommes que chez les femmes.

programme.title: Hélène reste en forme
programme.desc: L'alimentation est considérée comme l'un des piliers de la santé. Mais au-delà des grandes recommandations, comment savoir si notre alimentation est optimale pour être en forme ? Que faut-il manger avant, pendant et après avoir fait du sport ? Entre les calories, les nutriments, les vitamines, les protéines, glucides et lipides, qu'est-ce qu'on doit comprendre ?

programme.title: La préhistoire du Québec
programme.desc: Possiblement la plus ancienne chaîne de montagnes de la planète, les Laurentides ont de quoi étonner; l'érosion des millénaires en a beaucoup réduit la taille, mais un milliard d'années n'ont pas suffi pour les effacer complètement.

programme.title: Avant après
programme.desc: Le Quartier des spectacles, aujourd'hui le coeur culturel de Montréal, est depuis longtemps associé au côté festif de la ville; c'est dans ce secteur animé que se trouvait ce que l'on appelait le Red Light, dont l'origine remonte au 19e siècle.

programme.title: Kebec
programme.desc: Pauline Julien et Gérald Godin: la Renarde et le Mal Peigné, couple mythique inoubliable, atypique, libre; ces ardents militants continuent de nous inspirer.

programme.title: Le sommeil en questions
programme.desc: On se demande quels sont les impacts du changement d'heure sur la santé et quels seraient les avantages de rester toute l'année à l'heure normale ; Jean-Daniel Doucet questionne le professeur émérite Joseph De Koninck à ce sujet.

programme.title: Repenser le monde
programme.desc: Crises climatique et migratoire, inégalités croissantes et racisme systémique, jamais le contexte n'aura été aussi favorable à la gauche politique; les classes populaires, que la gauche a traditionnellement représentées, lui tournent le dos.

programme.title: Les lieux de pouvoir au Québec
programme.desc: L'Assemblée nationale est le lieu de pouvoir par excellence du Québec; que ce soit au Salon bleu ou au Salon rouge, c'est le cœur de notre démocratie depuis 1866; celles et ceux qui étaient aux premières loges racontent ce qu'ils y ont vécu.

programme.title: La clinique des mots
programme.desc: Que veulent dire les mots chondrosarcome, hémangiome et cancérogène; pourquoi est-ce qu'on associe le mot cancer à un crabe; oncologie 101.

programme.title: Trouvez l'erreur

programme.title: Accent grave
programme.desc: Les enseignants sont bien placés pour prendre le pouls de la qualité du français chez les élèves; on épluche les réformes du ministère, et on découvre des pistes de solutions pour faciliter la réussite.

programme.title: L'IA et moi
programme.desc: Dans sa quête d'efficacité, Philippe Desrosiers utilise plusieurs objets connectés, intelligents ou pas; il magasine dans une boutique connectée, conduit un prototype de voiture autonome et découvre comment l'IA transforme la prospection minière.

programme.title: Décarboner autrement
programme.desc: L'hydrogène est un gaz très abondant sur notre planète ; au Québec, avec l'hydroélectricité, on est capable de produire un hydrogène qui émet très peu de gaz à effet de serre ; mais cet hydrogène vert peut-il se tailler une place ?

programme.title: Les prix Acfas 2025

programme.title: La clinique des mots

Parrainé par la Fondation canadienne pour l'innovation.

programme.desc: Au Canada, les critères d'équité, de diversité et d'inclusion (EDI) dans les demandes de subvention en ont indigné plusieurs, qui craignent que certains projets de recherche soient mis à l'écart à cause d'un non-respect de ces critères.

programme.title: The Office
programme.desc: This U.S. adaptation -- set at a paper company based in Scranton, Pa. -- has a similar documentary style to that of the Ricky Gervais-led British original. It features the Dunder-Mifflin staff, which includes characters based on roles in the British show -- and, quite possibly, people with whom you work in your office. There's Jim, the likable employee who's a bit of an every man. Jim has a thing for receptionist-turned-sales-rep Pam -- because office romances are always a good idea! There's also Dwight, the co-worker who is successful but devoid of social skills and common sense.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Don't be ridiculous! When it comes to Internet videos run amok, however, the more zany, unbelievable and downright dangerous the clips are, the greater the chance they'll be shown on this series. It features amateur viral videos being critiqued by MTV personality Rob Dyrdek ("Rob Dyrdek's Fantasy Factory"), who knows a thing or two about pushing the envelope from his pro skateboarding days. With commentary from Sterling "Steelo" Brim and Chanel (the rapping receptionist from "Fantasy Factory"), Dyrdek breaks down the clips by putting them in such categories as "Hot Mess," "Worst Case Scenario," "Redneck Good Times" and "What Happened Last Night." It's sure to be seriously ridiculous.

It features amateur viral videos being critiqued by MTV personality Rob Dyrdek ("Rob Dyrdek's Fantasy Factory"), who knows a thing or two about pushing the envelope from his pro skateboarding days. With commentary from Sterling "Steelo" Brim and Chanel (the rapping receptionist from "Fantasy Factory"), Dyrdek breaks down the clips by putting them in such categories as "Hot Mess," "Worst Case Scenario," "Redneck Good Times" and "What Happened Last Night." It's sure to be seriously ridiculous.

programme.desc: Les Pierrafeu étaient la famille moderne de l'âge de la Pierre. Résidant dans la ville Saint-Granit, Fred Caillou n'était pas satisfait de son travail à la carrière, mais revenait à la maison auprès de sa charmante épouse Wilma et, enfin de sa fille Agathe. Fred, un grand amateur de golf et de quilles aimait aussi taquiner son voisin Arthur Laroche, tandis que la femme coquine d'Arthur, Bertha était la meilleure amie de Wilma. Au cours de l'émission, Barney et Betty ont adopté un fils anormalement fort, Bamm-Bamm, qui allait devenir plus tard ami avec Agathe. Les Pierrafeu, fortement inspiré par "The Honeymooners" ont convaincu une génération d'enfants que dinosaures et humains ont occupé la planète en même temps.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: Recognizing that Maj. Robert Parrish (Dale Robertson) has a history of making peace with Native American tribes, President Ulysses S. Grant (John Hamilton) sends him to iron out a land dispute with Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish). Though negotiations seem to be going well, Parrish can't stop the deadly Battle of Little Big Horn. Many die, but when he helps Sitting Bull survive, Parrish is charged with crimes against the government, and he will be executed unless Grant steps in.

programme.title: Man From Del Rio
programme.desc: Thanks to his prowess with a gun, Dave Robles (Anthony Quinn) makes a place for himself in Mesa, becoming sheriff after out-dueling several gunfighters in a single day. But Robles, a Mexican, seethes over the town's racism, and is warned by kindly nurse Estella (Katy Jurado) that without his gun, he would not last very long. That theory is put to the test when the new sheriff injures his wrist fighting with Ed Bannister (Peter Whitney), who upon learning about it, challenges Robles to a duel.

programme.title: Halliday Brand
programme.desc: As his father, Big Dan (Ward Bond), lies dying, estranged son Daniel Halliday (Joseph Cotten) returns to the family cattle ranch and recalls why he left home. Years before, Big Dan discovered that his daughter, Martha (Betsy Blair), was in love with Native American ranch hand Jivaro (Christopher Dark) and had the young man arrested on false charges. Outraged, Daniel left home and teamed with Jivaro's beautiful sister (Viveca Lindfors) and vengeful father (Jay C. Flippen) for retribution.

programme.title: Valerie
programme.desc: Versions differ as a Civil War hero (Sterling Hayden) stands trial out West for shooting his wife (Anita Ekberg) and her family.

programme.title: The Brass Legend
programme.desc: Sheriff Wade Addams (Hugh O'Brian) is engaged to Linda Gibson (Nancy Gates) and searching for an elusive killer, Tris Hatten (Raymond Burr). Linda's little brother, Clay (Donald MacDonald), happens upon Tris' hideout one day, and immediately notifies Wade, who arrests the killer. Despite efforts to keep Clay's involvement a secret, the details come out and Clay's life is threatened. Wade must protect Clay while sidestepping attempts on his own life by Tris' henchmen.

programme.title: The Iron Sheriff
programme.desc: When his son Benjie is accused of killing a stagecoach driver, Sheriff Sam Galt (Sterling Hayden) is convinced his boy is innocent. On a quest to clear his son's name, Galt spares no expense in hiring lawyers. While Galt's position as town sheriff raises suspicions of police misconduct, he makes it clear he won't stand in the way of the law. But that certainty is thrown into doubt when Galt goes on a search for the real murderer -- and makes a startling discovery.

programme.title: A Reason to Live, A Reason to Die
programme.desc: After surrendering Fort Holman to the Confederacy without there being a single shot fired, Col. Pembroke (James Coburn) faces public disgrace and a potential court-martial unless he's able to recapture the fort now held by the power-mad Maj. Ward (Telly Savalas). To help him on this mission, Pembroke enlists a ragtag bunch of condemned men who are promised their freedom should they survive. Despite much internal strife, the group gradually comes together in time for the assault.

programme.title: Quincannon, Frontier Scout
programme.desc: Linus Quincannon (Tony Martin) quits the U.S. Army in protest at the slaughter of Native Americans. He becomes a frontier scout, and is sent on an expedition to look into the disappearance of a cargo of munitions. He's joined by the lovely Maylene (Peggie Castle), who wants to find out if her brother died in an attack on a faraway fort. In a savage environment of hostile American Indians and renegade soldiers, Quincannon searches for the truth, and Maylene falls in love with him.

programme.title: War Drums
programme.desc: Mangas Coloradas (Lex Barker), an Apache chief, and white trader Luke Fargo (Ben Johnson) are bound by friendship and their mutual love for Riva (Joan Taylor), a Mexican-Native American girl rescued from horse thieves. Riva marries Mangas, who teaches her the warrior's ways, and she later warns the Apaches of an ambush by white soldiers. When Fargo, who did not intend an attack, is injured, Riva helps him -- a kindness he must choose whether or not to return when war with the Apaches erupts.

programme.title: California
programme.desc: A Mexican aristocrat (Michael Pate) dies leading troops against his half brother's rebels (Jock Mahoney) in old California.

programme.title: Outlaw's Son
programme.desc: Young Jeff Blaine (Joseph Stafford) is being raised by his Aunt Ruth (Ellen Drew) because his absentee father, Nate (Dane Clark), is an outlaw. When Nate suddenly shows up, hoping to get custody of Jeff, Ruth opposes the idea, and forces Nate to flee by framing him for a robbery. Years later, the adult Jeff (Ben Cooper), who never forgave Ruth for her deception, begins to search for his fugitive father, and becomes an outlaw himself when he engages in an ill-advised stagecoach robbery.

programme.title: Invitation to a Gunfighter
programme.desc: From worse to terrible -- Civil War veteran Matt Weaver (George Segal) arrives in New Mexico worn down from combat, only to discover his family plot has been requisitioned and sold by cutthroat property developer Sam Brewster. When Weaver attempts to reclaim his land, Brewster hires a reclusive gunman (Yul Brynner) to take him out. However, the gunman proves uncontrollable. He refuses to kill Weaver and instead tries to seduce his wife (Janice Rule), all the while wreaking havoc throughout town.

programme.title: The Dalton Girls
programme.desc: After the criminal Dalton brothers are slain, two of the brothers' eldest daughters, Holly and Rose, get into an altercation with an undertaker and are forced to kill him. On the run from Detective Hiram Parsh, who pursued the Dalton brothers for years, Holly and Rose take assumed names and begin a life of petty crime in order to get money to send their younger sisters, Columbine and Marigold, to school in the East.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: The uncle of an accused man sets a lethal trap for Bat at a Mexican ranch to prevent him from testifying at his nephew's trial.

programme.title: Bat Masterson

programme.desc: Lors de la compétition, Amy revoit un vieil ami, mais la rencontre lui cause de la peine; Jack et Lisa prouvent qu'ils peuvent être aventureux; puis, Katie se défend quand Ellie et Brandon la poussent à bout.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Quand la mort d'un lieutenant de la marine révèle des liens avec l'agent spécial Sawyer, Torres et Knight découvrent un meurtre lié à une riche famille ; pendant ce temps, Parker fait une découverte choquante reliant la mort de sa mère à Lily.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: When the son of a Marine that Gibbs once helped comes to NCIS in desperation, the fractured team reunites off the books; chasing justice without a badge may cost them more than their careers.

programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: As civil war rages through 1990s Sierra Leone, two men, a white South African mercenary (Leonardo DiCaprio) and a black Mende fisherman (Djimon Hounsou), become joined in a common quest to recover a rare gem that has the power to transform their lives. With the help of an American journalist (Jennifer Connelly), the men embark on a hazardous trek through rebel territory to achieve their goal.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: While searching the abandoned and bloody car of a missing Navy lieutenant, the team learns she had been profiling men to find the perfect mate.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs' team works with the Army Criminal Investigative Unit to investigate a suspected terrorist attack that killed a Marine colonel at a military country club.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: The team investigates the death of a missing lance corporal, whose body was buried in the backyard of a vacant house and then exhumed.

programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: As civil war rages through 1990s Sierra Leone, two men, a white South African mercenary (Leonardo DiCaprio) and a black Mende fisherman (Djimon Hounsou), become joined in a common quest to recover a rare gem that has the power to transform their lives. With the help of an American journalist (Jennifer Connelly), the men embark on a hazardous trek through rebel territory to achieve their goal.

programme.title: Private Eyes
programme.desc: Zoe Chow hires Shade and Angie to find out who broke into her apartment.

programme.title: Private Eyes
programme.desc: A teacher is accused of an inappropriate relationship and Shade and Angie investigate.

programme.title: Private Eyes
programme.desc: Fashion designer Carla Costa hires Shade and Angie to guard her new collection.

programme.title: Private Eyes
programme.desc: Shade and Angie are hired to find a missing woman who died three years ago.

programme.title: Memories of Murder
programme.desc: In 1986, Park (Song Kang-ho) and Cho (Kim Roi-ha) were two simple-minded detectives assigned to a double murder investigation in a South Korean province. But when the murderer strikes several more times with the same pattern, the detectives realize that they are chasing the country's first documented serial killer. Relying on only their basic skills and tools, Park and Cho attempt to piece together the clues and solve the case in this thriller based on true events.

programme.title: Gasoline Alley
programme.desc: Set in the underbelly of Los Angeles, a man is drawn into a high-profile triple murder. The two police detectives on his tail soon join him in attempting to uncover an explosive conspiracy.

programme.title: Run
programme.desc: Smugglers, the police, locals and tourists get drawn into a dangerous web of survival, sacrifice and shifting loyalties as Europe faces a surge in migration.

programme.title: Friday the 13th
programme.desc: Crystal Lake's history of murder doesn't deter counselors from setting up a summer camp in the woodsy area. Superstitious locals warn against it, but the fresh-faced young people -- Jack (Kevin Bacon), Alice (Adrienne King), Bill (Harry Crosby), Marcie (Jeannine Taylor) and Ned (Mark Nelson) -- pay little heed to the old-timers. Then they find themselves stalked by a brutal killer. As they're slashed, shot and stabbed, the counselors struggle to stay alive against a merciless opponent.

programme.title: Stop-Loss
programme.desc: His tour of duty in Iraq finally over, Staff Sgt. Brandon King returns home to Brazos, Texas, ready to re-enter civilian life. Unexpectedly, the Army invokes a clause in Brandon's military contract, requiring him to return to active duty in Iraq. With the help of close friend Michele, Brandon goes AWOL and struggles to find a way out of the dilemma.

programme.title: Nacho Libre
programme.desc: Ignacio (Jack Black), or Nacho to his friends, works as a cook in the Mexican monastery where he grew up. The monastery is home to a host of orphans whom Nacho cares for deeply, but there is not much money to feed them properly. Nacho decides to raise money for the children by moonlighting as a Lucha Libre wrestler with his partner Esqueleto (Héctor Jiménez), but since the church forbids Lucha, Nacho must disguise his identity.

programme.title: Mob Town
programme.desc: The FBI and a local cop track various members of organized crime families as they gather for a huge meeting in upstate New York in 1957.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
programme.desc: Breaking up with Mark Darcy (Colin Firth) leaves Bridget Jones (Renée Zellweger) over 40 and single again. Feeling that she has everything under control, Jones decides to focus on her career as a top news producer. Suddenly, her love life comes back from the dead when she meets a dashing and handsome American named Jack (Patrick Dempsey). Things couldn't be better, until Bridget discovers that she is pregnant. Now, the befuddled mom-to-be must figure out if the proud papa is Mark or Jack.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: After more than 30 years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators, Pete "Maverick" Mitchell is where he belongs, pushing the envelope as a courageous test pilot and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him. Training a detachment of graduates for a special assignment, Maverick must confront the ghosts of his past and his deepest fears, culminating in a mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice from those who choose to fly it.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Two years before the Civil War, Django (Jamie Foxx), a slave, finds himself accompanying an unorthodox German bounty hunter named Dr. King Schultz (Christoph Waltz) on a mission to capture the vicious Brittle brothers. Their mission successful, Schultz frees Django, and together they hunt the South's most-wanted criminals. Their travels take them to the infamous plantation of shady Calvin Candie (Leonardo DiCaprio), where Django's long-lost wife (Kerry Washington) is still a slave.

programme.title: Cheech & Chong's Last Movie
programme.desc: Cheech Marin and Tommy Chong discuss their lifelong friendship and popularity as a comedic duo. Features interviews, sketches and never-before-seen footage spanning their five-decade career.

programme.title: Grudge Match
programme.desc: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all.

programme.title: The Terminal
programme.desc: When Viktor Navorski (Tom Hanks), an Eastern European tourist, arrives at JFK in New York, war breaks out in his country, and he finds himself caught up in international politics. Because of the war, the Department of Homeland Security won't let him enter or exit the United States. He's trapped at JFK -- indefinitely. While living at the airport, Viktor falls for a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones). She may have feelings for him too. But what good is love if Viktor can't leave the terminal?

programme.title: Shell
programme.desc: Desperate to reclaim her career, once-beloved actress Samantha Lake gets drawn into the glamorous world of wellness mogul Zoe Shannon, only to uncover a monstrous truth beneath the seemingly flawless surface.

programme.title: Before We Vanish
programme.desc: Three aliens travel to Earth on a mission in preparation for a mass invasion. Having taken possession of human bodies, the visitors rob their hosts of the very essence of their being, leaving psychological and spiritual devastation in their wake.

programme.title: The Peacemaker
programme.desc: Two trains collide in rural Russia, one of them housing nuclear weapons that go missing after the wreck, and the U.S. government is alerted. Nuclear specialist Dr. Julia Kelly (Nicole Kidman) believes that there will soon be a terrorist attack, so Lt. Col. Thomas Devoe (George Clooney) joins Dr. Kelly as they try to track down the warhead-stealing culprits. They learn that Yugoslav terrorist Gavrich (Marcel Iures) has his hands on the weapons, and he's plotting a devastating attack on New York.

programme.title: Mindhunters
programme.desc: FBI agent Jake Harris (Val Kilmer) escorts a group of cadets to a remote island for simulation training. The cadets, under the leadership of J.D. (Christian Slater), will try to catch an imaginary serial killer within the island's elaborate facility. The FBI, however, is suspicious of Harris' methods and dispatch Gabe Jensen (LL Cool J) to act as an outside observer. What he finds is a simulation exercise that becomes dangerously real and training that becomes a fight for survival.

programme.title: Paycheck
programme.desc: Michael Jennings is a top-notch reverse engineer. Corporations pay him to crack the secrets of their competitors' products. When the job is done, he has his memory of it erased. Rethrick, head of a company called Allcom, hires Jennings to reverse-engineer a secret government device. After the job, Jennings wakes from the memory erasure to find himself being chased by various agencies. He soon realizes that the fate of the entire world may be in his hands.

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: The Enterprise and its crew follow a Borg ship through a time warp to prevent the Borg from taking over the Earth in a past era. Stuck in the past, Geordi La Forge helps a pioneer of space travel in his efforts to create the first warp drive while Capt. Picard and Cmdr. Data battle the Borg Queen as she tries to take over the Enterprise.

programme.title: Star Trek: Section 31
programme.desc: Emperor Philippa Georgiou faces the sins of her past after joining a secret division of Starfleet that's tasked with protecting the United Federation of Planets.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: As Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and Capt. Spock (Leonard Nimoy) monitor trainees at Starfleet Academy, another vessel from the United Federation of Planets is about to try out the planet-creating Genesis Device in a seemingly deserted portion of space. In the process, two of Kirk's officers are captured by Khan (Ricardo Montalban), an enemy Kirk thought he'd never see again. Once more, Kirk takes the Enterprise's helm, where he meets Khan's ship in an intergalactic showdown.

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) has defeated his archenemy but at great cost. His friend Spock has apparently been killed, the USS Enterprise is being scrapped, and starship physician Dr. Leonard "Bones" McCoy (DeForest Kelley) has taken ill. McCoy's odd behavior is evidence he's harboring Spock's katra, or animating spirit, and Kirk seeks to take the Enterprise back to the Genesis Planet and find his friend. Rebuffed, Kirk takes dramatic action that results in war with deadly Klingons.

programme.title: Star Trek: Nemesis
programme.desc: Capt. Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) diverts the starship Enterprise from its scheduled trip to Cmdr. Riker (Jonathan Frakes) and Counselor Troi's (Marina Sirtis) wedding to negotiate a peace treaty with the Romulans. Picard is shocked when Shinzon (Tom Hardy), the new Praetor of the Romulans, admits to being a clone of him. When the crew members discover a break-in on their computer, they are forced into a life-or-death battle to stop Shinzon's Warbird before it can destroy the Earth.

programme.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
programme.desc: A Federation mission to the planet Ba'ku takes a dangerous turn when a malfunctioning android, Data (Brent Spiner), takes a cultural task force hostage. When Capt. Picard (Patrick Stewart) and his crew investigate, they uncover the truth about the Federation mission: It was actually a systematic ploy by the Son'a to displace the peaceful inhabitants of Ba'ku. Now Picard and his crew must thwart the plot even while experiencing strange side effects from exposure to the planet's surface.

programme.title: Good Burger
programme.desc: Teen misfits (Kel Mitchell, Kenan Thompson) at a modest burger joint face competition from a hamburger emporium across the street.

programme.title: Shall We Dance?
programme.desc: Despite having a great career and a loving family, lawyer John Clark (Richard Gere) is missing something in his life as he meanders listlessly from day to day. On his commute back home one night, Clark notices a stunning woman (Jennifer Lopez) in a dance studio and decides on a whim to join a class for ballroom dancing. While Clark finds a new spark in his life, his wife, Beverly (Susan Sarandon), grows suspicious of his frequent absences, since he decides to keep his dancing a secret.

programme.title: Queen Bees
programme.desc: While her house undergoes repairs, fiercely independent senior Helen temporarily moves into a nearby retirement community, where she encounters lusty widows, cutthroat bridge tournaments and a hotbed of bullying "mean girls."

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: To the students at Harrington High, the principal and her posse of teachers have always been a little odd, but lately they've been behaving positively alien. Controlled by otherworldly parasites, the faculty try to infect students one by one. Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders.

programme.title: Maniac
programme.desc: A serial killer (Elijah Wood) removes his victims' scalps and attaches them to the vintage mannequins he restores in his late mother's shop.

programme.title: College
programme.desc: After his girlfriend dumps him, high-school senior Kevin (Drake Bell) does not feel like attending freshman orientation weekend at Fairmont University, but his pals (Andrew Caldwell, Kevin Covais) drag him along anyway. Once there, the teens meet members of the rowdiest fraternity on campus, who introduce them to the college party scene, as well as a few sorority girls.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: Boozy writer Marty (Colin Farrell) is a man in search of a screenplay. He has a catchy title but no story to go along with it. Marty has a couple of oddball buddies, Hans (Christopher Walken) and Billy (Sam Rockwell), who make a living by kidnapping rich people's dogs, then returning them and collecting the reward. However this time, the fur flies when Hans and Billy kidnap the beloved pooch of a gangster (Woody Harrelson), and Marty uses the ensuing events as fodder for his screenplay.

programme.title: Drillbit Taylor
programme.desc: For three misfit freshmen, the first day of high school becomes a living hell when Filkins (Alex Frost), the school bully, zeroes in on them. Chubby Ryan (Troy Gentile), diminutive Emmit (David Dorfman) and skinny Wade (Nate Hartley) all feel the wrath of Filkins. Realizing that their own chance for survival is to hire a bodyguard, the pals place an ad in the newspaper. Answering the call is Drillbit Taylor (Owen Wilson) ; armed, dangerous and completely fake.

programme.title: Dean
programme.desc: An illustrator falls in love with a woman while trying to keep his father from burning down the family home after his wife dies.

programme.title: I Used to Go Here
programme.desc: A successful author finds herself deeply enmeshed in the lives of a group of college students after being asked to speak at her alma mater.

programme.title: Passion Play: Russell Westbrook
programme.desc: Rare footage and extensive interviews provide insight into the dynamic life and career of NBA player Russell Westbrook.

programme.title: Doin' It
programme.desc: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education.

programme.title: Scary Movie 4
programme.desc: Dim-witted Cindy Campbell (Anna Faris) and her sex-crazed friend, Brenda (Regina Hall), team up with cute-but-clueless Tom Ryan (Craig Bierko) to save the world from a hostile alien invasion, with hints of War of the Worlds, Saw II, Million Dollar Baby and The Village. Celebrity cameos include Carmen Electra, Shaquille O'Neal, Dr. Phil McGraw, Bill Pullman, Molly Shannon and Michael Madsen.

programme.title: Scary Movie V
programme.desc: Much bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn infant home from the hospital. When they realize that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal specialists and install numerous cameras to drive out the pesky spirit. Movies that are spoofed in the familiar format include the "Paranormal Activity" franchise, "Mama," "Sinister," "Evil Dead," "Inception," "Black Swan" and "Rise of the Planet of the Apes."

programme.title: Jackass: The Movie
programme.desc: In this comedic documentary, Johnny Knoxville heads a crew of stuntmen, skateboarders and all-around lunatics as they prank, embarrass and torture each other in the name of fun. The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly.

programme.title: Jackass: Number Two
programme.desc: Daredevils (Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O) go for the gross-out when they subject an unsuspecting public to more outrageous stunts and practical jokes. Danger, pain and bodily fluids are in plentiful supply as the gang tries to up the ante in the continuous quest to shock and annoy.

programme.title: Jackass 3
programme.desc: Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O, Wee Man and the rest of their fearless and foolhardy friends take part in another round of outrageous pranks and stunts. In addition to standing in the path of a charging bull, launching themselves into the air and crashing through various objects, the guys perform in segments such as "Sweatsuit Cocktail," "Beehive Tetherball" and "Lamborghini Tooth Pull."

programme.title: The Infernal Machine
programme.desc: Bruce Cogburn, a reclusive and controversial author of the famed book "The Infernal Machine," is drawn out of hiding when he begins to receive endless letters from an obsessive fan. What ensues is a dangerous labyrinth as Bruce searches for the person behind the cryptic messages, forcing him to confront his past and ultimately revealing the truth behind the book.

programme.title: Not Without Hope
programme.desc: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as Capt. Timothy Close and his Coast Guard crew launch a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them.

programme.title: Uncommon Valor
programme.desc: Col. Cal Rhodes (Gene Hackman), a retired Marine officer, holds out hope that his son, believed to be a prisoner of war in Laos, is still alive. Despite the government's refusal to help Rhodes, he assembles a group to find and rescue his son, including skilled soldiers such as Wilkes (Fred Ward) and Sailor (Randall "Tex" Cobb). Funded by MacGregor (Robert Stack), a wealthy executive also looking for his son, Rhodes leads his men on a dangerous mission into the jungles of Laos.

programme.title: Bride and Prejudice
programme.desc: With four beautiful daughters of marrying age, Manorama (Nadira Babbar) and Chaman Bakshi (Anupam Kher) frantically seek out the perfect husbands for their children. Yet their eldest daughter, Lalita (Aishwarya Rai), is intent upon marrying at her own choosing, for love. Lalita endures a number of hopeful suitors, but the American William Darcy (Martin Henderson) seems different -- and not always in a good way. Misunderstandings, schemes and lies threaten to keep the two from true love.

programme.title: The Wedding Banquet
programme.desc: Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things soon get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with plans for an extravagant Korean wedding banquet.

programme.title: A Single Man
programme.desc: George is a college professor who recently lost his lover, Jim, in a car accident. Terribly grief-stricken, George plans to commit suicide. As he goes about his daily routine and puts his affairs in order, his encounters with colleagues, students and an old friend lead him to make a final decision whether life is worth living without Jim.

programme.title: Stepping Out
programme.desc: A professional singer/dancer (Liza Minnelli) grooms her diverse amateur-dance class for a charity tap show.

programme.title: The Fan
programme.desc: Broadway star Sally is successful, famous and working on a new musical. But she's in love with ex-husband Jake, and his absence creates a void in her life. Despite her loneliness, she doesn't reciprocate when a fan, Douglas, starts sending her letters. This angers the delusional admirer so much that he starts getting violent. With secretary Belle and others caught up in the drama, Sally's career and well-being are jeopardized.

programme.title: Wishful Thinking
programme.desc: Wishful Thinking

programme.title: The Sense of an Ending
programme.desc: A business owner (Jim Broadbent) reunites with his first love (Charlotte Rampling) after a letter and a diary force him to confront the past.

programme.title: Regarding Us
programme.desc: After losing her teaching career in the Catholic school system, a transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children, one with two fathers in marital strife, and the other a recent transplant from a conservative household. When the children form a unique bond, new questions and old prejudices erupt.

programme.title: Pretty Red Dress
programme.desc: The story of Travis, Candice and their daughter, Kenisha, and their relationships with the same red dress.

programme.title: Regarding Us
programme.desc: After losing her teaching career in the Catholic school system, a transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children, one with two fathers in marital strife, and the other a recent transplant from a conservative household. When the children form a unique bond, new questions and old prejudices erupt.

programme.title: The Killing of Kenneth Chamberlain
programme.desc: The events that led to the death of Kenneth Chamberlain Sr., an elderly African American veteran with bipolar disorder, who was killed during a conflict with police officers who were dispatched to check on him.

programme.title: Hotel Artemis
programme.desc: As rioting rocks Los Angeles in the year 2028, disgruntled thieves make their way to Hotel Artemis -- a 13-story, members-only hospital for criminals. It's operated by the Nurse, a no-nonsense, high-tech healer who already has her hands full of a French assassin, an arms dealer and an injured cop. As the violence of the night continues, the Nurse must decide whether to break her own rules and confront what she's worked so hard to avoid.

programme.title: The Chi
programme.desc: The South Side of Chicago carries daily danger, and the smallest and simplest of decisions can have life or death consequences for the residents. Life continues as the kids prep for school and their parents shuffle off to work. The young adults of the area are trying to scrape a living for themselves, while the elders sit on their front porches and observe the goings on. The South Side has the potential to crush dreams, and this coming-of-age series focuses on Kevin, a preteen who embraces the normal rites of childhood, Brandon, who makes a leap of faith to succeed in love and life with Jerrika, Emmett, who seeks guidance from his mother, and Ronnie, who is a drifter struggling to be loved. All of them are linked together by sheer coincidence as they seek redemption.

programme.title: Hitsville: The Making of Motown
programme.desc: Motown Records becomes the most successful label of all time after its formation in 1958 Detroit amid racial tension and the burgeoning civil rights movement.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse
programme.desc: In 1908 an outlaw returns from years of hiding in Mexico to claim stolen gold hidden in the hills of Montana.

programme.title: The Resurgence: DeMarcus Cousins
programme.desc: A documentary following DeMarcus Cousins while he recovers from an injury that has been a career death sentence for some NBA players; featuring exclusive interviews with teammates, coaches and NBA insiders.

programme.title: Seaside
programme.desc: A woman decides to run away to the Oregon coast with her boyfriend when he inherits a family beach house.

programme.title: Sabrina
programme.desc: Chauffeur's daughter Sabrina (Audrey Hepburn) returns home from two years in Paris a beautiful young woman, and immediately catches the attention of David (William Holden), the playboy son of her father's rich employers. David woos and wins Sabrina, who has always been in love with him, however their romance is threatened by David's serious older brother, Linus (Humphrey Bogart), who runs the family business and is relying on David to marry an heiress in order for a crucial merger to take place.

programme.title: Charade
programme.desc: After Regina Lampert (Audrey Hepburn) falls for the dashing Peter Joshua (Cary Grant) on a skiing holiday in the French Alps, she discovers upon her return to Paris that her husband has been murdered. Soon, she and Peter are giving chase to three of her late husband's World War II cronies, Tex (James Coburn), Scobie (George Kennedy) and Gideon (Ned Glass), who are after a quarter of a million dollars the quartet stole while behind enemy lines. But why does Peter keep changing his name?

He and his men join forces with Bridget von Hammersmark, a German actress and undercover agent, to bring down the leaders of the Third Reich. Their fates converge with theater owner Shosanna Dreyfus, who seeks to avenge the Nazis' execution of her family.

programme.title: The Reckoning

The people labor under the yoke of two oppressive powers - the Church laying claim to their souls and the Knights, the feudal warlords, who command life or death. Nicholas (Paul Bettany), a young priest, is discovered in the act of adultery by a husband who dies in the ensuing struggle. Appalled by his fall from grace, he turns his back on the Church and goes on the run.

programme.title: Funny Face

He gets Jo to go with him to France, where he snaps more pictures of her against iconic Parisian backdrops. In the process, they fall for one another, only to find hurdles in their way.

programme.title: Delia's Gone
programme.desc: Accused of murdering his sister, a man with an intellectual disability embarks on a quest to clear his name and find out who's responsible.

programme.title: Stage Fright

programme.title: Ballerine
programme.desc: Une assassine formée selon les traditions de l'organisation Ruska Roma part en quête de vengeance après la mort de son père.

programme.title: Wick Is Pain
programme.desc: Des séquences inédites et l'histoire derrière le phénomène John Wick, passé d'un film indépendant à une franchise valant des milliards.

programme.title: Mesures funèbres

programme.title: Insaisissable 3

Accompagnés d'un groupe de jeunes magiciens qui espèrent suivre leur trace, ils vont devoir repousser les limites de l'illusion pour orchestrer leur tour le plus spectaculaire: dérober le joyau le plus précieux du monde des mains d'une redoutable organisation criminelle.

programme.title: Gâteau à l'assassinat: une enquête d'Hannah Swensen
programme.desc: Quand la cliente d'Hannah et rivale de théâtre de Dolorès est assassinée, Hannah doit trouver le coupable pour sauver la réputation de sa mère. Pendant ce temps, la romance entre Chad et Hannah s'épanouit.

programme.title: La prisonnière de Bordeaux
programme.desc: Alma, seule dans sa grande maison en ville, et Mina, jeune mère dans une lointaine banlieue, ont organisé leur vie autour de l'absence de leurs deux maris détenus au même endroit. À l'occasion d'un parloir, les deux femmes se rencontrent et s'engagent dans une amitié aussi improbable que tumultueuse.

programme.title: Tarte aux morts: une enquête de Hannah Swensen
programme.desc: L'émission de téléréalité préférée d'Hannah prend le contrôle de "The Cookie Jar." Lorsque le producteur est retrouvé mort, Hannah et Norman font équipe pour retrouver le meurtrier. Chad invite Hannah au tribunal.

programme.title: Blindé
programme.desc: Un père et son fils travaillant comme agents de sécurité pour une société de camions blindés rencontrent une équipe de voleurs potentiels sur un pont. Ils se retrouvent piégés et doivent élaborer un plan pour s'échapper.

programme.title: Barcelone, mon amour
programme.desc: Erica, traductrice américaine, remanie en secret un roman qui se déroule à Barcelone. Tout bascule pour elle lorsque Nico, le propriétaire d'une librairie, invite Anna, l'autrice officiellement créditée, pour une séance de dédicaces en ville.

programme.title: Les linceuls
programme.desc: Karsh, 50 ans, est un homme d'affaires renommé. Inconsolable depuis le décès de son épouse, il invente un système révolutionnaire et controversé, Gravetech, qui permet aux vivants de se connecter à leurs chers disparus dans leurs linceuls. Une nuit, plusieurs tombes, dont celles de sa femme, sont vandalisées. Karsh se met en quête des coupables.

programme.title: Petit ange doux
programme.desc: Eliza est un membre modeste et apprécié d'une petite communauté de pêcheurs qui voit toutes ses relations mises en péril après que sa personnalité secrète sur les réseaux sociaux a été révélée.

programme.title: Mlle Bottine
programme.desc: Philippe, un compositeur d'opéra en panne d'inspiration, se voit forcé d'héberger sa nièce Simone, une orpheline rebelle et excentrique dont la meilleure amie est une moufette ; malgré leurs personnalités diamétralement opposées, Philippe et Simone découvrent rapidement qu'ils pourraient avoir besoin l'un de l'autre plus qu'ils ne l'auraient initialement cru.

programme.title: Good Boy
programme.desc: Un chien fidèle déménage avec son maître dans une maison de campagne, où il découvre l'existence de forces surnaturelles qui rôdent dans l'ombre. Alors que des entités maléfiques menacent son maître, le courageux chien se bat pour protéger celui qu'il aime le plus.

programme.title: La plus précieuse des marchandises

Un bébé jeté d'un des nombreux trains qui traversent sans cesse leur bois. Protégée quoiqu'il en coûte, ce bébé, cette petite marchandise va bouleverser la vie de cette femme, de son mari, et de tous ceux qui vont croiser son destin, jusqu'à l'homme qui l'a jeté du train. Leur histoire va révéler le pire comme le meilleur du coeur des hommes.

programme.title: Le seigneur des anneaux: la guerre des Rohirrim
